changes: Retain (pid, boot_id, start_ticks) and verify each identity immediately before every signal.
Observe surviving owned identities after reparenting; never signal an unverified numeric process group.
Every normal, memory-stop, cancellation and exception reap uses WNOWAIT observation before releasing the original leader PID.
Capture the root identity before allowing spawn cancellation; clean descendants discovered during compiled finally cleanup.

verification.method: Run scripts/run_tests.py in explicit source/process lanes under a separate supervisor using unchanged OwnedProcessTree, shared serial_lock and bounded tree RSS, system memory, logs and lifetime.

failures_and_repairs.finding: Initial process selection had four pilot fixture failures before host launch.
failures_and_repairs.cause: Existing synthetic fixture omitted frozen role-profile admission and did not stub verify_frozen_configuration.
failures_and_repairs.repair: Stub configuration admission only in the synthetic host-failure fixture so its intended host cleanup boundary executes.
failures_and_repairs.verification: All four failed cases passed in the focused repair run and final 35-case process run.

failures_and_repairs.finding: First independent review reproduced a child leak when a root TERM handler forked after cleanup sampling.
failures_and_repairs.cause: Cleanup Popen.wait reaped the root before the next identity observation.
failures_and_repairs.repair: Unify every wait/reap path through WNOWAIT observation and clean newly discovered descendants after compiled finally.
failures_and_repairs.verification: Three new real-process regressions passed; the independent reviewer inverted and reran the original counterexample successfully.

limits: Linux /proc sampling and identity checks remain a trusted-local emergency brake rather than an OS isolation boundary.
Never-observed descendants which completely detach retain unknown resource coverage.
The full suite, live model lane and real scientific workloads were not run for this focused scripting change.
Raw supervision logs are local /tmp evidence; this record retains their decision-relevant results.
